duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset) in seconds

sample.Description: Onset of the event according to the sampling scheme of the recorded modality

trial_type.Description: Primary categorisation of each trial to identify them as instances of the experimental conditions.

stim_file.Description: Represents the location of the stimulus file (image, video, sound etc.) presented at the given onset time. They should be stored in the /stimuli folder (under the root folder of the dataset; with optional subfolders). The values under the stim_file column correspond to a path relative to "/stimuli".

onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event measured from the beginning of the acquisition of the first volume in the corresponding task imaging data file

value.Description: Marker value associated with the event. The Levels enumeration below is the source dataset's documented mapping (preserved verbatim, with the `x` prefix stripped to match the bare integer cells in the events.tsv data).

Levels.13: First moment of mouse movement for the perceptual task
Levels.15: Onset of the confidence judgment task
Levels.16: First moment of mouse movement for the confidence task
Levels.6: Undocumented in source; appears only in sub-S37/ses-1 (2 occurrences). Listed here so the Levels enumeration covers every value actually present in the events.tsv data.

event_description.Description: Verbatim description of the event from the source dataset's `Levels` mapping for the `value` column (above). Pure lookup: for each row, the value of `value` is used as the key into `value.Levels` and the corresponding description string is copied here. 'n/a' for value=6 (undocumented in source).
